propositions: Inbound fetcher currently resolves only a single query_project and builds one JQL pair, causing multi-project stores to ingest data from only one project while silently dropping enrichment data (parent/comment/issuelink maps) for other configured projects
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project provenance, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset

Fan-out implementation must issue active+done JQL pair and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink) once per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot deduplicated by jira key
Per-query truncation ceiling must be enforced per project independently, not as a shared budget, so a single busy project cannot exhaust capacity on behalf of others

Source project and default repos must be derived and stamped at CREATE write time using jira_key prefix and projects_store mapping lookup, with no new signature changes to core apply_inbound functions
